title: Concentrating Fourier Family
statement: For a natural number $n$, a real-valued function $f$ on the sign cube $\\{−1,1\\}^n$, and a real number $\\varepsilon$, the concentrating Fourier family consists of those subsets $S\\subseteq[n]$ for which $\\varepsilon\\leq \\|\\widehat f\\|_1 |\\widehat f(S)|$, where $\\|\\widehat f\\|_1$ is the sum of the absolute values of all Fourier coefficients of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
